# Image2Base64 — Free Image ↔ Base64 Data URI Converter

> image2base64.com is a free, browser-based image to Base64 converter. Files are converted entirely on the user's device with the FileReader API — no upload, no sign-up, no server-side processing. It encodes any image (PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP, SVG, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO) to a typed `data:image/...;base64,...` URI with ready-to-paste HTML, CSS, and JSON output, and decodes Base64 strings back into downloadable image files.

Core user value: turn an image into a self-contained text string for inline embedding in HTML, CSS, email signatures, JSON API payloads, or single-file deliverables — and turn Base64 strings back into files.

## Encode: image to Base64

- [Image to Base64](/): Universal converter for any image format — PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, SVG.
- [PNG to Base64](/png-to-base64): Encode PNGs with transparency preserved.
- [JPG to Base64](/jpg-to-base64): Encode JPEG photos; .jpg and .jpeg supported identically.
- [WebP to Base64](/webp-to-base64): Encode modern WebP images.
- [SVG to Base64](/svg-to-base64): Encode vector SVGs for CSS and HTML embedding.
- [GIF to Base64](/gif-to-base64): Encode GIF animations into a data URI.
- [TIFF to Base64](/tiff-to-base64): Encode TIFF files, a legacy/scanning format.
- [HEIC to Base64](/heic-to-base64): Encode iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos locally (no-preview in Chrome).
- [BMP to Base64](/bmp-to-base64): Encode Windows bitmap files to Base64.

## Decode: Base64 to image

- [Base64 to Image](/base64-to-image): Decode a Base64 string back into a downloadable file.
- [Base64 to PNG](/base64-to-png): Decode and save as PNG.
- [Base64 to JPG](/base64-to-jpg): Decode and save as JPEG.
- [Base64 to WebP](/base64-to-webp): Decode and save as WebP.
- [Base64 to SVG](/base64-to-svg): Decode vector SVG markup.
- [Base64 to GIF](/base64-to-gif): Decode and save as a GIF.

## Specialized tools

- [Compress PNG to Base64](/compress-png-to-base64): Compress, then encode PNGs.
- [Compress JPG to Base64](/compress-jpg-to-base64): Compress, then encode JPEGs.
- [Data URI Generator](/data-uri-generator): Turn any image into a data URI for CSS or HTML.
- [Base64 Favicon](/base64-favicon): Inline a favicon with a data URI link tag.
- [Image to Base64 for API](/image-to-base64-for-api): Build Base64 payloads for OpenAI/Cloud Vision-style JSON APIs.
- [Extract Base64 Image from CSS](/extract-base64-image-from-css): Pull embedded images out of CSS/HTML source.
- [Base64 Image Size Calculator](/base64-image-size-calculator): Estimate encoded size and the ~33% overhead.
- [Base64 Image Email Signature](/base64-image-email-signature): Build signature images that survive email clients.

- [OpenAI Vision Base64 Image](/openai-vision-base64-image): The image_url data URI payload GPT-4o/GPT-4.1 expect, with limits and failure modes.
- [Cloud Vision Base64 Image](/cloud-vision-base64-image): Raw Base64 (no prefix) in images.annotate's image.content, with size limits and batching.
- [Base64 Image in HTML Email](/base64-image-in-html-email): Data URI vs CID vs hosted — client support matrix and per-provider working patterns.
- [How Much Bigger Is a Base64 Image?](/base64-overhead-measured): The measured 33% overhead on five real assets, and what transport compression gives back.
- [Data URI Images in Email Clients](/base64-image-email-clients): Which clients usually render data URIs, the common failure modes, and the CID or hosted-image fallbacks.
- [When Not to Inline Images as Base64](/when-not-to-inline-base64): Caching, repetition and render-priority costs — and the cases where inlining still wins.
- [SVG: Data URI vs Inline SVG](/svg-base64-vs-inline-svg): Styling, id clashes and quoting for icons, favicons and CSS backgrounds.
- [Sending Images in JSON APIs](/base64-in-json-apis): Base64 in JSON vs multipart vs presigned URLs, by image size and endpoint type.
- [Data URIs and CSP](/data-uri-csp-security): Which directives should allow data: and which must never.

## Troubleshooting

- [Fix Invalid Base64 Image Data](/fix-invalid-base64-image-data): Diagnose broken or truncated data URIs.
- [Base64 Image Not Showing in Outlook](/base64-image-not-showing-in-outlook): Why Outlook desktop blocks inline Base64.
- [Gmail Signature Base64 Not Working](/base64-image-in-gmail-signature-not-working): Gmail's inline image restrictions explained.
- [Embed Base64 Image in Markdown](/embed-base64-image-in-markdown): Which renderers allow data URIs — GitHub, Notion and WordPress restrictions explained.
- [Power Automate Base64 Image in Email](/power-automate-base64-image-in-email): The working Compose + base64() pattern for inline images, and why they still don't render.
- [Apps Script Base64 Image in Email](/google-apps-script-base64-image-in-email): Gmail rejects data URIs in mail — decode to a blob and send via inlineImages with a cid: reference.
- [Excel VBA Base64 Image in Outlook Email](/excel-vba-base64-image-outlook-email): ADODB.Stream + MSXML encoding in VBA, and the hidden-attachment CID pattern Outlook requires.
- [SendGrid Inline Image with Base64](/sendgrid-inline-image-base64): attachments + content_id + disposition inline, cid: in the HTML — and why data URIs get stripped.
- [Send Base64 Image via Telegram Bot](/telegram-bot-send-base64-image): sendPhoto rejects data URIs — decode the payload and upload as multipart.
- [Slack Base64 Image Not Working](/slack-base64-image-not-working): Slack answers no_file_data for raw Base64 — strip the prefix and upload as multipart.
- [Send Base64 Image with Discord.js](/discord-js-send-base64-image): Decode the payload to a Buffer and wrap it in AttachmentBuilder.
- [Trello Attachments with Base64](/trello-api-upload-attachment-base64-multipart): The API only accepts multipart file parts — decode Base64 to bytes and upload.
- [Freshdesk Attachments via API](/freshdesk-api-attachments-base64-not-supported): No Base64 JSON field — multipart attachments[] with curl/Node/Python examples.
- [SharePoint Base64 Upload Fix](/sharepoint-rest-api-upload-base64-image-corrupted): Files/add stores the body as-is; decode Base64 before uploading.
- [OneDrive Graph Base64 Upload](/onedrive-graph-api-upload-base64-not-decoded): PUT /content never decodes; decode first, upload bytes, verify size.
